sentence: This project builds a solver for high-dimensional partial differential equations that combines tensor-network, Monte Carlo and convex optimization methods.
This project builds web servers and databases that model proteins, peptides and small molecules in lipid membranes.
This project builds a sensor made of porous silicon and paper that measures disease biomarkers using a smartphone camera.
This project develops ways to represent queries and documents more compactly so document retrieval runs fast on standard, affordable hardware.
This project develops subsampling methods for choosing which data points to label in large and high-dimensional datasets.
This project assembles a complete genome sequence for the pinyon pine to study how its genes respond to climate change.
This project builds an algorithm that uses natural abundances of carbon-13 to measure the rates and types of metabolism in bacteria.
This project designs a spherical wind-powered rover that can move in all directions, including upwind.
This project builds a toolchain that helps researchers of human-centered AI protect the privacy of people in their studies by collecting less data.
This project develops methods for accurate and reliable geo-referencing of geospatial data from sources such as smartphones, drones and satellites.
This project makes explainable AI methods faster at showing how a model reached a decision, with tests on histopathology imaging and single-cell RNA sequencing.
This project builds flexible and faster covariance models for Gaussian processes, using Fourier methods to handle large datasets.
This project studies how groups of neurons across four brain areas work together when macaque monkeys make flexible decisions.
This project builds memory devices that store data in synthetic-DNA combined with organometallic halide perovskite semiconductors.
